title: pvGenericIOReader
body:
## pvGenericIOReader

Reads HACC GenericIO particle files (.gio) into one unstructured grid of particles (vtkPGenericIOReader): xAxis, yAxis and zAxis name the coordinate variables, PointArrayStatus chooses the other variables to load, and HalosToLoad with HaloId can restrict reading to particles of chosen halos. Several file names form a time series. Its output suits pvANLHaloFinder; use pvGenericIOMultiBlockReader to keep the file's blocks separate and pvMultiResGenericIO for multi-resolution .gios sets.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Set xAxis, yAxis and zAxis; without valid coordinate variables no points are produced.
- ParaView marks the GenericIO readers mpi_required; Schemaxis's serial writer fixture read a GenericIO file successfully with pvGenericIOMultiBlockReader, but other files are unverified.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GenericIOReader`. Identity: `sources/GenericIOReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BlockAssignmentStrategy` | Method used to assign blocks to processes. | `{"type":"enum","values":["RoundRobin","RCB (contiguous)"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"RoundRobin"` |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `HaloId` | Which data array in the file contains the halo ids. This is used with the halo ids to load to determine which points to load. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `HalosToLoad` | Only load in points with these halo ids from the file. If no halo ids are specified, load all the points. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Names of the GenericIO variables to load as point arrays on the particles (for example vx, vy, vz, id, fof_halo_tag). Unlisted variables are not read, which saves memory; the coordinate variables named by xAxis, yAxis and zAxis are always read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `QueryRankNeighbors` | If checked, only the data of the RankInQuery and its neighbors will be rendered. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `RankInQuery` | Used in combination with QueryRankNeighbors, this property tells the reader to only render the data of this rank and its neighbors. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ReadMethod` | Method used for reading, either MPI or POSIX is used. | `{"type":"enum","values":["MPI","Posix"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"MPI"` |
| `xAxis` | Name of the GenericIO variable used as the first (x) particle coordinate. All three coordinate variables must exist in the file, otherwise the reader reports missing coordinate arrays and produces no points. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `yAxis` | Name of the GenericIO variable used as the second (y) particle coordinate. All three coordinate variables must exist in the file, otherwise the reader reports missing coordinate arrays and produces no points. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `zAxis` | Name of the GenericIO variable used as the third (z) particle coordinate. All three coordinate variables must exist in the file, otherwise the reader reports missing coordinate arrays and produces no points. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},

  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvGenericIOReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
